description: Source file implementing the DataElement class and related functionality within the WPEFramework Core namespace, including CRC32 calculation, buffer management, and data copying for linked data elements.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a data buffer with CRC32 checksum calculation.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Represents a linked list of data buffers with methods for buffer manipulation and copying.

methods.name: uint32_t CRC32(const uint64_t offset,const uint64_t size) const
methods.description: Calculates the CRC32 checksum over a specified range within the data buffer.

methods.name: void GetBuffer(uint64_t offset,uint32_t size,uint8_t * buffer) const
methods.description: Retrieves a segment of the buffer, handling boundary crossing.

methods.name: void SetBuffer(uint64_t offset,uint32_t size,const uint8_t * buffer)
methods.description: Sets data into a segment of the buffer, handling boundary crossing.

methods.name: uint64_t Copy(const uint64_t offset,const LinkedDataElement & copy)
methods.description: Copies data from another linked data element into this one.
